The Postbox is an online submission facility which allows buyers to receive responses from suppliers electronically in a secure environment. Responses are submitted through the portal and held in the secure Postbox until the deadline for responses has expired. Nominated members of the buyer organisation then unlock the Postbox to access the submissions. The Postbox can be used for the receipt of PQQs, tender responses, Quick Quote submissions and all supporting documents. A full audit trail is kept of all access to the Postbox and a complete record of all supplier submissions is stored. Please note: Before you can use the postbox you must record your interest in a notice. deliverables_scope.text:
ainability actions, and support decision-making in a structured and operational way. The project is funded under the Horizon Europe programme and is implemented through a Pre-Commercial Procurement (PCP) process, ensuring that the future solution responds to real and validated needs from the sector.

suHCO will conduct the Open Market Consultation (OMC) through a series of events designed to:
- Inform potential suppliers about suHCO’s upcoming pre-commercial procurement opportunities
- Explain the pre-commercial procurement process in detail
- Open a dialogue with potential suppliers regarding the project’s envisaged scope and technical requirements
- Facilitate matchmaking among suppliers seeking partners to form consortia capable of fully addressing the needs of the suHCO procurers

There will be OMCs at each procurer site in local language and one international OMC in English.
